title: Your Stomach Acid Can Dissolve Metal
fact: Gastric acid in your stomach has a pH of 1-2, which is strong enough to dissolve some metals. It can break down food and kill bacteria that enter your digestive system.

title: Octopuses Have Three Hearts
fact: Octopuses have three hearts. Two pump blood to the gills, while the third pumps blood to the rest of the body. When they swim, the heart that pumps blood to the body actually stops beating.

title: Bananas Are Radioactive
fact: Bananas contain potassium-40, a radioactive isotope. This makes them slightly radioactive, but you would need to eat about 10 million bananas at once to die from radiation poisoning.

title: The Eiffel Tower Grows in Summer
fact: The Eiffel Tower can grow up to 15 centimeters (6 inches) taller during the summer months due to thermal expansion of the iron structure.

title: Your Brain Uses 20% of Your Oxygen
fact: Even though your brain only makes up about 2% of your body weight, it consumes approximately 20% of your body's oxygen supply.
